items.text: Izwi likaJehova lafika kimi, lathi:
Ndodana yomuntu, kwakukhona abesifazane ababili, amadodakazi onina munye;
Bafeba eGibithe; bafeba ebusheni babo; kwacindezelwa khona amabele abo, balimaza khona isifuba sobuntombi babo.
Amagama abo kwakungu-Ohola izibulo, no-Oholiba udadewabo; futhi baba ngabami, futhi bazala amadodana namadodakazi. Ayenjalo amagama abo; ISamariya lingu-Ohola, iJerusalema lingu-Oholiba.
U-Ohola waphinga esengowami; wafisa izithandwa zakhe kuma-Asiriya, abakhelwane bakhe;
Babembethe izingubo eziluhlaza, izinduna nezinduna, zonke izinsizwa ezinxanelekayo, abamahhashi begibele amahhashi.
Wafeba nabo, nabo bonke abakhethiweyo base-Asiriya, nabo bonke ayebakhanukela; wazingcolisa ngazo zonke izithombe zabo.
Futhi akashiyanga ubufebe bakhe abakhishwa eGibithe; ngoba ebusheni bakhe balala naye, baphula amabele obuntombi bakhe, bathululela ubufebe babo phezu kwakhe.
Ngakho ngamnikela esandleni sezithandwa zakhe, esandleni sama-Asiriya ayewalangazelela.
Bambula ubunqunu bakhe, bathatha amadodana akhe namadodakazi akhe, bambulala ngenkemba, waduma phakathi kwabesifazane; ngoba bamahlulela.
Lapho udadewabo u-Oholiba ekubona, wayekhohlakele kakhulu ngothando lwakhe oludlulele kunaye, nobufebe bakhe kunodadewabo ebufebeni bakhe.
Wayebathanda abase-Asiriya, abakhelwane bakhe, nezinduna zakhe, nababusi, ababevunule kahle, nabamahhashi abakhwele amahhashi, izinsizwa ezinxanelekayo zonke.
Ngase ngibona ukuthi ungcolile, ukuthi bobabili bahamba indlela eyodwa;
Wandisa ubufebe bakhe, ngokuba lapho ebona abantu bechithwa odongeni, izithombe zamaKaledi zithululwa ngokubomvu;
Bebhince amabhande ezinkalweni zabo, abaningi begqoke izingubo ezidayiwe emakhanda abo, zonke izikhulu ukuze zibheke indlela yabaseBhabhiloni baseKaledi, izwe lokuzalwa kwabo.
Lapho ewabona ngamehlo akhe, wawafisa, wathumela izithunywa kuwo eKaledi.
AbaseBhabhiloni beza kuye embhedeni wothando, bamngcolisa ngobufebe babo, wangcoliswa ngabo, lomphefumulo wakhe wehlukana labo.
Wasembula ubufebe bakhe, wembula ubunqunu bakhe;
Kodwa wandisa ubufebe bakhe ngokukhumbula izinsuku zobutsha bakhe lapho aphinga ngazo elizweni leGibhithe.
Ngokuba walangazelela izithandwa zabo, ezinyama yazo injengenyama yezimbongolo, nokugeleza kwazo kunjengokugeleza kwamahhashi.
Ngakho wakhumbula ihlazo lobutsha bakho, ngokuchotshozwa kwezingono zakho ngabaseGibhithe ngenxa kayise wobutsha bakho.
Ngalokho, Oholiba, isho kanje iNkosi uJehova; Bheka, ngiyakuvusela izithandwa zakho ezisukile kuzo inhliziyo yakho, ngizilethe kuwe zivela nxazonke;

abaseBhabhiloni nawo wonke amaKaledi, oPhekodi noShowa noKowa nawo wonke ama-Asiriya kanye nawo, zonke izinsizwa ezinxanelekayo, izinduna nababusi, izikhulu ezinkulu nezidumile, bonke abagibele amahhashi.

Bayakukufikela benezinqola, nezinqola, namasondo, nesixuku sabantu abayakumisa isihlangu nesihlangu nesigqoko nxazonke zakho; futhi ngiyobeka umthetho phambi kwabo, futhi bayokwahlulela ngokwezahlulelo zabo.

Futhi ngizobeka ukushisekela kwami phezu kwakho, futhi bayobhekana nawe; bayakususa ikhala lakho nezindlebe zakho; insali yenu iyakuwa ngenkemba; bayakuthatha amadodana akho namadodakazi akho; futhi insali yakho iyoqedwa ngomlilo.
Futhi bayokuhlubula izingubo zakho futhi bathathe amagugu akho amahle.
Ngakho ngiyokwenza ukuba ihlazo lakho liphele kuwe nasebufebeni bakho owakhishwa ezweni laseGibhithe, ukuze ungawaphakamiseli amehlo akho kubo futhi ungabe usacabanga ngeGibhithe.
Ngokuba isho kanje iNkosi uJehova, ithi: Bheka, ngiyakunikela esandleni salabo obazondayo, esandleni salabo inhliziyo yakho ihlubuke kubo.
Bayokwenza kuwe ngenzondo, bathathe wonke umshikashika wakho, bakushiye uhamba-ze, ubonakalisiwe; nehlazo lobufebe bakho liyokwambulwa, ihlazo lakho kanye nobufebe bakho.
Ngizakwenza lokhu kuwe, ngoba usuphingile ngokulandela abezizwe, langokungcoliswa kwenu ngezithombe zabo.
Wahamba ngendlela kadadewenu; ngalokho ngiyakunikela indebe yakhe esandleni sakho.
Isho kanje iNkosi uJehova, ithi: Uyakuphuza endebeni kadadewenu ejulile, enkulu; uyakuhlekwa, uhlekwe; iqukethe okuningi.
Uyakugcwala ukudakwa nosizi, endebeni yokumangala neyencithakalo, indebe yodadewenu iSamariya.
Uyowuphuza, uwumunce, uphihlize izingcezu zawo, uklebhule amabele akho, ngokuba mina ngikhulumile, isho iNkosi uJehova.
Ngalokho isho kanje iNkosi uJehova, ithi: Ngokuba ningikhohliwe, ningilahle ngemuva kwakho, nithwale ihlazo lakho nobufebe bakho.
Futhi uJehova wathi kimi: “Ndodana yomuntu, uyathanda ukwahlulela o-Ohola no-Oholiba na? yebo, memezela kubo izinengiso zabo;
ukuthi baphingile, legazi lisezandleni zabo, baphingile lezithombe zabo, lamadodana abo abangizalele wona, bawadabulile emlilweni ukuze abaqede.
Bakwenza lokhu kimi: bangcolisa indlu yami engcwele ngalona lolo suku, bawona amasabatha ami.
Lapho bebulala abantwana babo ngenxa yezithombe zabo, bangena ngalona lolo suku endlini yami engcwele ukuyingcolisa; futhi bheka, benza kanjalo endlini yami.
Futhi wathuma amadoda evela kude, okwathunyelwa kuwo isithunywa; bheka, bafika; owagezela yena, wapenda amehlo akho, wazihlobisa ngezivunulo;
wahlala embhedeni omuhle, walilungisela itafula, wabeka phezu kwalo impepho yami namafutha ami.
Ilizwi lexuku elaliduduzwa lalikanye laye, kanye lamadoda avamileyo balethwa amaSabeya avela enkangala, ethwele amasongo ezandleni lemiqhele emihle emakhanda awo.
Ngase ngithi kuye osemdala ngokuphinga: Kalokhu bayakuphinga naye, yena kanye nabo, na?
Kodwa bangena kuye njengoba bengena kowesifazana ophingayo; bangena ke ku-Ohola no-Oholiba abesifazane abakhanukayo.
Futhi amadoda alungile, ayobahlulela ngokwendlela yeziphingi nangokwendlela yabesifazane abachitha igazi; ngoba bayiziphingi, legazi lisesandleni sabo.
Ngokuba isho kanje iNkosi uJehova, ithi: Ngiyakukhuphulela isixuku ukuba silwe nabo, ngibanike ukuba basuke, bachithe.
Isixuku siyobakhanda ngamatshe sibakhiphe nezinkemba zaso; kumelwe babulale amadodana abo namadodakazi abo futhi bashise izindlu zabo ngomlilo.
Ngakho ngizaqeda inhlamba elizweni, ukuze bonke abesifazana bafundiswe ukuthi bangenzi njengehlazo lakho.
Bayakuniphindisela ngamahlazo enu, nithwale izono zezithombe zenu; nizokwazi ukuthi ngiyiNkosi uJehova.
